purpose: Cross-domain repeated-run stability benchmark for viability, claim selection, routing, support judgment, and inventory over-trigger as a negative control.

cases.source: A Randomized Trial of Intensive versus Standard Blood-Pressure Control (SPRINT)
packet: High-risk adults without diabetes were randomized to intensive versus standard systolic blood-pressure targets.
The primary composite cardiovascular event rate was lower under intensive treatment (reported hazard ratio about 0.75, confidence interval excluding 1).
All-cause mortality was also lower during observed follow-up, while several treatment-related adverse events were more frequent.
Prespecified subgroup heterogeneity was assessed with interaction tests and multiplicity adjustment.
Interim monitoring used a prespecified group-sequential framework rather than ad hoc stopping.

candidates.text: Intensive treatment reduced the primary cardiovascular outcome in the enrolled population.
The trial found no convincing evidence that the primary treatment effect differed across prespecified subgroups.
The presence of subgroup analyses and early stopping makes the primary result intrinsically unreliable.
The intensive target is established as preferable for essentially all adults with hypertension.
Treatment-related adverse events were more frequent under intensive treatment.

cases.source: Effect of Al Content on Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of CoCrFeNiMn High-Entropy Alloy
packet: Across increasing Al content, XRD changes from FCC toward an FCC+BCC mixture with greater BCC contribution.
Yield strength rises from about 281.9 to 358.1 MPa while elongation falls from about 0.52 to 0.12.
Reported hardness values are about 199.8, 196.8, 197.6, and 210.1 HV across the tested Al series.
Summary prose states that hardness continuously increases with Al content.
The paper attributes ductility loss primarily to formation of an ordered B2/NiAl brittle phase.

candidates.text: Increasing Al changes the tested alloy toward an FCC+BCC dual-phase structure with greater BCC contribution.
Yield strength increases while ductility decreases across the tested alloys.
Hardness increases continuously across every tested Al composition.
An ordered B2/NiAl phase is uniquely established as the primary causal origin of embrittlement.
Every measured mechanical property improves monotonically as Al content increases.

cases.source: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
packet: Matched plain and residual convolutional networks are compared on ImageNet; the deeper residual model has lower training and validation error than its plain counterpart.
Residual models are also evaluated over several depths on CIFAR-10 and on detection tasks.
The paper argues that residual functions may be easier to optimize because they are closer to zero.
The broad discussion suggests residual learning is a generic principle beyond the demonstrated vision tasks.
The deepest tested CIFAR model does not monotonically outperform every shallower residual model.

candidates.text: Residual connections make the tested deeper networks easier to optimize than matched plain networks.
Within tested residual families, increased depth can improve benchmark accuracy without the degradation seen in matched plain networks.
Residual functions being closer to zero is established as the causal reason optimization improves.
The paper establishes a generic residual-learning principle across non-vision domains.
More residual-network depth always monotonically improves accuracy.

cases.source: Integrating Cost-Effective Measurements and CFD Modeling for Accurate Air Quality Assessment
packet: The study combines low-cost air-quality sensors, high-quality monitoring stations, and CFD modeling for PM10 assessment in a 1.6 × 2 km urban area in Augsburg.

The CFD workflow incorporates traffic emissions, meteorological inputs, and an urban-background reference measurement, then compares model outputs with separate observed wind-speed data and two official air-quality stations.
During the representative 24 h period, modeled wind speed had R = 0.87 with about 7% average deviation, while modeled PM10 showed strong agreement with the two official stations.
Regression-based calibration of low-cost sensors improved their agreement with modeled values and with the two reference monitoring stations during the examined period.
The paper discusses broader uses of the method, but the demonstrated calibration is bounded to one urban deployment and a representative 24 h period.

candidates.text: The CFD workflow reproduces observed wind and PM10 behavior with substantial agreement during the studied Augsburg period.
The model-assisted calibration improves the low-cost sensor datasets during the examined 24 h deployment.
The workflow is established as accurate across other buildings, cities, seasons, and sensor deployments.
Combining reference measurements with CFD can provide a bounded calibration aid for the studied low-cost sensor network.
CFD modeling is inherently invalid when measurement data are also incorporated into the workflow.

cases.source: How Screen Time and Social Media Hyperconnection Have Harmed Adolescents’ Relational and Psychological Well-Being since the COVID-19 Pandemic
packet: The study analyzes two representative cross-sectional surveys of Italian adolescents conducted in 2019 and 2022.
Screen-time and social-media hyperconnection measures are associated with relational and psychological outcomes.
The reported analyses state that hyperconnected adolescents were about 1.4 times more likely to experience negative psychological states than their peers.
The title and discussion use causal language such as harmed, although exposure was not randomized and the same individuals were not followed through controlled exposure changes.

candidates.text: Greater screen time and social-media hyperconnection are associated with worse relational or psychological outcomes in the surveyed adolescents.
Screen time and social-media hyperconnection harmed adolescent relational and psychological well-being.
Reducing social-media exposure would improve an individual adolescent's mental health.
The pandemic itself caused the observed relationship between screen use and well-being.
Hyperconnected adolescents were about 1.4 times more likely to report negative psychological states in the reported analyses.

cases.source: The Price Impact of Order Book Events
packet: The study analyzes order-book events for 50 US stocks over a defined historical period.
Over short intervals, price changes are strongly related to order-flow imbalance, and the empirical relation is approximately linear.
The estimated slope of the order-flow-imbalance relation is inversely proportional to market depth.
The reported relation is robust to intraday seasonality and stable across time scales and across the studied stocks.
The paper uses causal-sounding price-impact language, while the evidence is observational market microstructure data rather than randomized intervention.

candidates.text: Order-flow imbalance is strongly associated with contemporaneous price changes in the studied stocks and period.
The estimated relation uniquely establishes that order-flow imbalance causally moves prices by the reported amount.
The slope of the order-flow-imbalance relation is inversely related to market depth in the reported analyses.
The reported order-flow-imbalance relation is stable across time scales and across the studied stocks.
The paper demonstrates a profitable trading strategy after transaction costs.

cases.source: Impact of round goby on native invertebrate communities - An experimental field study
packet: A field experiment uses 12 cages to examine effects of round goby on native invertebrate communities in a macrophyte habitat in the Åland Islands.
Round goby presence decreased overall invertebrate abundance, biomass, and taxon richness under the tested conditions.
Gobies also altered taxonomic and trait composition and were associated with lower overall invertebrate body size because larger individuals were preferentially consumed.
The paper discusses possible consequences for other trophic levels, trophic cascades, ecosystem functioning, and invaded areas beyond the local experiment.

candidates.text: Round goby reduced native invertebrate abundance, biomass, or taxon richness in the tested field-cage experiment.
The experiment establishes a trophic cascade affecting ecosystem functioning in invaded ecosystems generally.
The local experimental effect can be generalized directly to other invaded areas.
Round goby altered trait composition and decreased overall invertebrate body size under the tested conditions.
Twelve cages are equivalent to twelve independent invaded ecosystems.

cases.source: A scalable method for preparing Cu electrocatalysts that convert CO2 into C2+ products
packet: The study prepares copper electrocatalysts using a scalable route and measures CO2 electroreduction selectivity.
The tested catalysts show high Faradaic efficiency toward multi-carbon products under reported conditions.
Microscopy and structural characterization associate performance with morphology, roughness, and defect-related features.
The study does not directly observe one unique active site throughout operation.
The paper discusses transfer of the preparation-property relationship beyond the exact tested reactor/condition set.

candidates.text: The tested preparation method yields copper catalysts with high C2+ selectivity under the reported conditions.
A specific defect-density or roughness feature is uniquely established as the causal active origin of the high selectivity.
The preparation-property relationship is established as broadly transferable across CO2 electroreduction reactors and operating regimes.
The characterization is consistent with a structure-performance relationship.
High Faradaic efficiency proves a unique microscopic active-site mechanism.
